description: Winning Visual transforms categorical data into an engaging podium-style ranking with playful characters. It highlights winners, runners-up, and the remainder in a clear and memorable way—perfect for storytelling dashboards, performance comparisons, and top-N analysis. The visual is highly configurable yet easy to set up. Customize podium count, relative sizing, characters, medals, signs, colors, and labels to match your brand or narrative—without complex configuration. Whether you want a serious ranking or a fun presentation, Winning Visual adapts to your needs. Best for: -- Top-N and ranking scenarios -- Category performance comparisons -- Storytelling and executive dashboards -- Making data fun and memorable Simple to start, powerful to customize—turn your rankings into winners. 🎉
